title: Fluorescence mechanism of poly(2-vinylnaphthalene) driven by local ordering and restricted motion
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,22775-22783
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01104G, Paper
Open Access

Qiannan Zhang, Pingchuan Sun, Baohui Li
The fluorescence mechanism of poly(2-vinylnaphthalene) (P2VN), exhibiting aggregation-induced emission (AIE) characteristics, is systematically investigated through a combination of theoretical calculations and experimental characterizations.
